title: rel00.0-uc002 format: Implement size formatting, ANSI colors, and column alignment
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/format/ component -- responsibility and capabilities)
  - docs/specs/use-cases/rel00.0-uc002-format.yaml (use case for output formatting library)
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/ (find and read the PRD for pkg/format -- glob for prd*format*.yaml in this directory)
  - docs/specs/test-suites/test-rel-00.0.yaml (test suite for release 00.0, format section)
  - pkg/testutils/difftest.go (reference for existing package conventions: copyright header, SPDX, doc comments, naming)

files:
  - path: pkg/format/size.go
    action: create
    note: "Human-readable size formatting (bytes to K/M/G/T/P/E, binary and decimal bases)"
  - path: pkg/format/color.go
    action: create
    note: "ANSI color codes for Unix file types and permission display"
  - path: pkg/format/columns.go
    action: create
    note: "Column alignment for tabular output (ls -l style), width as parameter"

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Implement human-readable size formatting that converts byte counts to abbreviated suffixes (K, M, G, T, P, E). Support both binary base (powers of 1024, matching GNU --human-readable) and decimal base (powers of 1000, matching GNU --si). Format output to match GNU coreutils conventions: no space between number and suffix, one decimal digit when the value is less than 10."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement ANSI color output for Unix file types. Provide color codes for at least: directory (blue), symlink (cyan), executable (green), pipe/FIFO, socket, block device, character device, and regular file. Follow GNU LS_COLORS environment variable conventions for color assignment."
  - id: R3
    text: "Implement column alignment for tabular output. Provide a type or function that formats rows into aligned columns with configurable padding, supporting both left-aligned and right-aligned columns. Accept output width as a parameter -- do not query terminal size. This supports ls -l, ls -C, and similar columnar layouts."
  - id: R4
    text: "Handle edge cases for all formatters: zero-byte sizes display as '0', size formatting handles values up to exabyte range without overflow, color output supports a no-color mode that emits no ANSI escape sequences, and column alignment handles empty input and single-column input without error."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "pkg/format does not import pkg/sys. Column alignment accepts width as a parameter; the caller obtains terminal width from pkg/sys or other sources."
  - id: D2
    text: "Follow existing package conventions from pkg/testutils/difftest.go: copyright header (Copyright (c) 2026 Petar Djukic. All rights reserved.), SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT, package doc comment referencing PRD requirement IDs with the Implements comment pattern."
  - id: D3
    text: "Use only the Go standard library (fmt, strconv, strings, os). Do not import golang.org/x/sys or any external dependency."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "go build ./pkg/format/ succeeds with no errors."
  - id: AC2
    text: "go vet ./pkg/format/ reports no issues."
  - id: AC3
    text: "pkg/format/size.go exports at least one function for human-readable size formatting that supports both binary (1024) and decimal (1000) base conversions."
  - id: AC4
    text: "pkg/format/color.go exports types or constants covering all seven Unix file types listed in R2, plus a mechanism to disable color output."
  - id: AC5
    text: "pkg/format/columns.go exports a type or function that aligns multi-column output given row data and a target width parameter."
  - id: AC6
    text: "All three source files include copyright header and package doc comment following the pattern in pkg/testutils/difftest.go."

title: rel00.0-uc004 testutils: Implement DiffTest struct and differential test runner
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (pkg/testutils component description, data structures section for DiffTest, design decision DD2)
  - docs/specs/use-cases/rel00.0-uc004-testutils.yaml (testutils use case -- how the harness is invoked)
  - docs/specs/test-suites/test-rel-00.0.yaml (test suite for rel00.0 including testutils acceptance tests)
  - "docs/specs/product-requirements/ (find and read the testutils PRD in this directory -- filename matches prd*testutils*.yaml)"
  - go.mod (module path for package declaration)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct, RunDiffTests function, comparison logic, normalization hooks

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: "Define an exported DiffTest struct with fields for: test name, command-line arguments, stdin input, environment variables, and expected exit code. The struct captures everything needed to run one differential test case against two binaries."
  - id: R2
    text: "Implement an exported RunDiffTests function that accepts *testing.T, a path to the Go binary under test, a path to the reference GNU binary, and a slice of DiffTest cases. For each case, execute both binaries with identical stdin, arguments, and environment using os/exec, capturing stdout, stderr, and exit code from each."
  - id: R3
    text: "Compare stdout, stderr, and exit code from the Go binary against the reference binary for each test case. Report divergences via testing.T (t.Run per case, t.Errorf on mismatch), including the test name, input arguments, expected output from the reference binary, and actual output from the Go binary."
  - id: R4
    text: "Support normalization hooks -- optional caller-provided functions that transform stdout or stderr before comparison. Apply normalization to both reference and Go binary output before comparing. This handles known acceptable differences such as timestamps or temporary file paths."

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: "Primary source file is difftest.go because the primary exported type is DiffTest. Project convention: name the file after the primary exported type, not the package name."
  - id: D2
    text: "Use os/exec.Command to invoke binaries. Pipe stdin from the test case via cmd.Stdin, capture stdout and stderr into bytes.Buffer, extract exit code via type assertion on *exec.ExitError from cmd.Run() error."
  - id: D3
    text: "Integrate with go test: RunDiffTests takes *testing.T and calls t.Run(tc.Name, ...) for each DiffTest case. Differential tests appear as standard Go subtests in test output and fail the test binary on any divergence."

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: "pkg/testutils/difftest.go exists and compiles without errors (go build ./pkg/testutils/...)."
  - id: AC2
    text: "DiffTest struct is exported with fields for Name, Args, Stdin, Env, and ExitCode at minimum."
  - id: AC3
    text: "RunDiffTests is exported and executes both the Go binary and reference binary per test case, comparing stdout, stderr, and exit code."
  - id: AC4
    text: "Normalization hooks are accepted by the API and applied to both outputs before comparison."
  - id: AC5
    text: "Code passes golangci-lint with no warnings (golangci-lint run ./pkg/testutils/...)."
